purpose: Initial design language for Signal Intelligence surfaces — observatory / ranger briefing, not SOC or Hollywood.
metaphor: Calm observatory and park-ranger briefing for invisible environments
principles: Severity is labeled language, not neon theater
One composition per view — especially Overview
Signal Card is the interaction container; avoid card nests
Empty and stable states are features

typography.hierarchy: Brand/product quiet; signal summary clear; metadata secondary

color.direction: Quiet neutrals with restrained accent for focus — not purple glow, not blood-red walls

severity.high: strong label still without siren chrome

color.confidence: Use Trust recommendation labels; never decorative percentages

layout.overview: Four-panel intelligence dashboard — Changed / Important / Attention / Stable
layout.detail: Single Signal Card column with expandable Evidence
layout.library: Grouped module index — filter, do not infinite-scroll news
layout.densityBudget: Prefer one calm desktop viewport; stack panels on small screens

motion.attentionEnter: Soft highlight settle — no pulse sirens

cssTokensSuggested.--si-bg: quiet paper or soft slate — product-theme aligned
